notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch + embedded __NEXT_DATA__ JSON parsing) was sufficient; site is SSR Next.js and serves full category/product data server-side. robots.txt (https://www.quince.com/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific full-site disallow (Claude-SearchBot only blocks /account, /log-in, /p/ etc., same as Googlebot) so Tier 3 was never needed. Checked: sitemap.xml -> sitemap_us.xml -> sitemap_shop.xml (541 PLP URLs), sitemap_subcollections.xml (1185 URLs), sitemap_misc.xml, plus the /shop/home and /shop/home/all-decor mega-menu/facet JSON, all scanned for christmas|holiday|halloween|easter|valentine|thanksgiving|diwali|new-year|seasonal|festive|wreath|ornament|stocking|santa|pumpkin|menorah|hanukkah|garland|advent. Quince.com is a multi-department storefront (Women's, Men's, Kids & Baby, Home, Gift); only the Home department is in scope for this Home-Decor extraction. Found exactly ONE genuine Home-department seasonal/holiday category: /shop/home/christmas-trees ('Christmas Trees for Home' PLP, breadcrumb home > christmas trees, qty from context.pageDataJson.widgets[2].data.filterSortData.total = 16, page type CLP with full SEO/FAQ content confirming it is an established, dedicated category, not a temporary landing page). This same 16-item listing is also reachable via /shop/home/all-decor/holiday-decor (a 'Product Type' facet inside the All Decor PLP, identical product titles and identical filterSortData.total=16) -- this is a duplicate nav path to the same underlying listing, so only one row was kept (the dedicated /shop/home/christmas-trees URL) per the duplicate-listing rule; the dup is recorded here. EXCLUDED as not genuine seasonal home-decor categories, with reasons: (1) /shop/seasonal-home-fragrance ('Scents of the Season', 16 candles/diffusers) -- grouped by time-of-year scent notes (Pumpkin Cardamom, Balsam Fir, Spiced Noelle) with no holiday name in title/breadcrumb/meta; this is seasonal timing, not a site-declared holiday association, so it fails boundary rule 2. (2) /shop/gifts/valentines and its sub-paths (for-women, for-men, colors-we-love, for-going-out, for-staying-in, baby-and-kids) -- confirmed via departments facet to span Women's/Men's/Kids&Baby/Home (891 total items), i.e. a cross-department marketing gift guide, not a Home-specific PLP. (3) /shop/gifts/valentines/for-women/home and /shop/gifts/valentines/for-men/home -- these are the 'Home' department filter of the same Valentine's gift guide (110 and 63 items respectively); inspected product titles and they are ordinary bedding/sheet SKUs (e.g. 'Twin / Ivory') with no Valentine's-specific product identity -- a curated gift-guide subset of the regular catalog, not a genuine seasonal category, so excluded. (4) /shop/gifts/stocking-stuffers -- cross-department gift guide (173 items across Women's/Men's/Kids&Baby/Home/Gift departments), excluded as a marketing/gift-guide page. (5) /shop/kids-and-baby/halloween, /shop/holiday-sweaters(-and-pajamas), /shop/holiday-pajamas, /shop/dressed-in-holiday-style -- all apparel (costumes, sweaters, pajamas) under the Kids&Baby or general apparel departments, not the Home department, so out of scope for this Home-Decor extraction regardless of holiday association. No Thanksgiving, Diwali, New Year, or Easter home-decor category exists anywhere in the sitemap or nav/facet data (only a Kids&Baby 'easter-dresses' apparel item was found, also out of scope). No zero-result site-search was relied upon; absence was established via full sitemap enumeration plus mega-menu/facet JSON inspection as detailed above.
